# Notice for the icons in this folder

The icon files come from Simple Icons 16.31.0 (npm package `simple-icons`). The package is released under CC0 1.0 (see `LICENSE.md`). Some icons have their own licence. The package data names it for each icon. Read `DISCLAIMER.md` before you reuse an icon.

The build script copies the path data of each icon into the stack board and fills it with one colour. A change of colour is a change to the icon. These five icons have their own licence:

| Icon | Licence | Source | What this repository does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `javascript.svg` | MIT | github.com/voodootikigod/logo.js, commit 1544bde | The licence text is in `LICENSE-javascript.txt`. |
| `gnubash.svg` | MIT | github.com/odb/official-bash-logo, commit 61eff02 | The licence text is in `LICENSE-gnubash.txt`. |
| `git.svg` | CC BY 3.0 | git-scm.com/community/logos | Git Logo by Jason Long, licensed under CC BY 3.0. Recoloured. |
| `rust.svg` | CC BY-SA 4.0 | rust-lang.org, media guide | The Rust logo is owned by the Rust Foundation. Recoloured. The recoloured Rust glyph in the stack board is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. |
| `tauri.svg` | CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 | github.com/tauri-apps/tauri-docs | Not used. This licence does not allow a changed copy, so the file is not in this folder. The stack board shows the etched mark `TA` instead. |

Every brand mark stays a trademark of its owner. The marks are used only to name the tools that the owner of this profile uses.
